# StackedBars

Seller revenue by channel as stacked bars, with a Day / Week toggle; point at or focus a bar and the headline scrubs to that bar.

`IK.StackedBars` · Seller tools

## Use

```jsx
<IK.StackedBars datasets={…} series={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="IK.StackedBars" datasets="{{…}}" series="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (StackedBarsProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `datasets` * | `Record<string, BarDataset>` | One entry per period; more than one shows the Day / Week toggle. |
| `series` * | `BarSeries[]` |  |
| `defaultPeriod` | `string` |  |
| `title` | `string` |  |
| `format` | `(n: number) => string` | Formats totals and legend values. Default: rupees, en-IN. |
| `height` | `number` | Plot height in px including the x labels. Default 180. |

### BarDataset

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `string` | Toggle label: "Week". |
| `caption` | `string` | Kicker after the title when nothing is hovered: "last 7 days". |
| `bars` * | `Array<{ label: string; values: Record<string, number> }>` |  |

### BarSeries

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` * | `string` |  |
| `label` * | `string` |  |
| `tone` | `1 \| 2 \| 3` | 1 = chart-1 (darkest) … 3 = chart-3 (lightest). |
